summary: Tested Calendar Sync Features - PATCH /api/meetings/{id} for outlook_event_id, meetings list/calendar APIs, marketing campaigns API, tasks API. All 16 tests passed, 1 skipped (sourcing follow-ups endpoint not found). Fixed 1 frontend bug in UnifiedCalendarPage.jsx.

bugs_fixed.issue: Tasks API response uses 'tasks' key but frontend code was looking for 'items' key - causing task deadlines to not appear on unified calendar

TestMeetingsPATCH.test_patch_disallowed_fields_ignored: PASS - Disallowed fields (title, etc) are filtered out

TestMeetingsListWithDateRange.test_list_meetings_returns_list: PASS - GET /api/meetings returns list of meetings
TestMeetingsListWithDateRange.test_list_meetings_with_date_range: PASS - GET /api/meetings with start_date/end_date filters works

TestTasksAPI.test_tasks_paginated_returns_data: PASS - GET /api/tasks/paginated returns paginated tasks with 'tasks' key

TestSourcingFollowUps.test_sourcing_follow_ups_endpoint: SKIPPED - No sourcing follow-ups endpoint found at expected paths

features_verified: 1. PATCH /api/meetings/{id} - Partial update endpoint works correctly
2. PATCH endpoint allows updating: outlook_event_id, google_event_id, sync_status, external_links
3. PATCH endpoint filters out disallowed fields (title, description, etc)
4. GET /api/meetings - List meetings with optional date range filters
5. GET /api/meetings/calendar - Calendar-optimized endpoint for date range
6. POST /api/meetings - Create meeting with sync_to_outlook flag
7. GET /api/marketing/v2/unified-campaigns - Returns marketing campaigns for calendar
8. GET /api/tasks/paginated - Returns tasks with due_date for calendar deadlines
9. /calendar route properly configured in frontend routing
10. UnifiedCalendarPage fetches from multiple sources: Outlook, Meetings, Marketing, Sourcing, Tasks
action_items: Sourcing follow-ups API endpoint (/api/sourcing/follow-ups) appears to not exist - calendar page will silently fail for this source. Consider implementing or removing from unified calendar.
critical_code_review_comments: The syncMeetingToOutlook function in CreateMeeting.jsx makes direct Microsoft Graph API calls from frontend - this works but requires user to have ms_access_token in localStorage. The PATCH endpoint is correctly used to persist the outlook_event_id after sync.
UnifiedCalendarPage gracefully handles API failures with try/catch for each source - good error isolation
seed_data_creation: Test meetings prefixed with TEST_ created and cleaned up during tests
context_for_next_testing_agent: Calendar sync features tested. PATCH /api/meetings/{id} works for updating outlook_event_id after Outlook sync. Unified Calendar at /calendar route fetches from 5 sources (Outlook via MS Graph, internal meetings, marketing campaigns, sourcing follow-ups, task deadlines). Note: sourcing follow-ups endpoint was not found - this silently fails. Tasks API returns data under 'tasks' key not 'items'.
